description: Attach an externally published video that this saved Brief produced. Requires the exact Brief ID, not a reference video. Reuses canonical video identity; duplicate conflicts preserve the original binding and baseline. URL resolution may incur collection cost under existing backend billing controls. Omitted trackingItemIds explicitly selects all workspace tracking; provide target IDs and region for scoped evidence. This does not publish content or prove causal uplift. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation and any quote/approval, budget and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.
